findings.title: handoff write ignores a pending gate, needs-human status and entry checks, then overwrites data.gate
findings.x-fix: In write, before closing phase P, reject with E_GATE_PENDING/E_BLOCKING_OPEN (exit 3) when data.gate.required && !data.gate.approved_by or status is needs-human, and re-run the phase entry checks (or require receive to have populated entry_checked). Only then reset gate at line 319. Add a relay test.
findings.x-evidence: Line 289 only compares next_phase; line 319 replaces gate with approved_by:null. receive (175-176) enforces the gate but write does not, so skipping receive erases an unapproved scope or pre-code gate (C6).

findings.title: Review write trusts agent-asserted blocking_findings and defaults next to land instead of routing to implement/work
findings.x-fix: In write --phase review, derive review.blocking_findings from review.json (open P0/P1) and ignore the supplied count; when >0 set next to implement (feature) or work (quick) automatically per phase-contracts; make no-blocking-findings (checks.mjs:207) recompute from the file.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: review.json with an open P0 and asserted blocking_findings:0 wrote next=land and receive --phase land exited 0. An honest count without --next still produced next=land status=ready. phase-contracts.md says Review -> implement is chosen automatically.

findings.title: Converge re-entry cannot be written: after_converge handoff always fails with E_TRANSITION
findings.x-fix: Mirror the receive exception (line 172): accept write --phase implement --mode converge when phase_completed is implement, keep next_phase review, and append history. Add a relay test for the write side.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: after receive --mode converge, write --phase implement (with or without --mode converge) exits 1 "Expected review, not implement"; the handoff hook maps after_converge to implement. relay.test.mjs:241 only covers receive.

findings.title: before_specify receive has no first-phase path: crashes with E_INTERNAL (exit 10) or rejects an escalated quick baton
findings.x-fix: In receive --phase specify, return a first-phase result (exit 0, read_first from --from-brainstorm/--from-quick or empty) when no feature baton exists; guard readdir(specs) and a missing handoff.md with E_MISSING_ARTIFACT instead of ENOENT; accept an escalated quick baton (next_phase specify) despite lane feature (line 171).
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: fresh repo -> E_INTERNAL scandir specs exit 10; feature dir without baton -> E_INTERNAL ENOENT handoff.md exit 10. receive.md promises a CLI first-phase result.

findings.title: after_specify write has no plain-feature path, and handoff new --feature hardcodes next_phase clarify so specify --next plan is impossible
findings.x-fix: Let write --phase specify --feature F create the first baton when none exists (like --from-brainstorm without a source), or have handoff new set phase_completed none/next_phase specify; keep the NEEDS CLARIFICATION guard for --next plan.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: write --phase specify --feature 001-alpha without a baton -> E_INTERNAL ENOENT; after handoff new --feature -> E_TRANSITION "Expected clarify, not specify". README/quickstart allow skipping clarify.

findings.title: Feature is not inferred from the branch; any repo with two feature dirs breaks every hook call without --feature
findings.x-fix: Implement contracts/cli.md:32: infer the feature from the NNN-slug branch name or .specify/feature.json before falling back to the single-dir rule; include the candidate list in the E_USAGE message.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: two specs dirs -> handoff next exits 2 E_USAGE. receive.md/handoff.md hook prompts never pass --feature.

findings.title: update overwrites merged .specify/extensions.yml and Copilot hooks with the pristine payload, dropping adopter hooks
findings.x-fix: Apply the same mergeExtensions/mergeHooks step as init.mjs:238-253 to the staged desired bytes before comparing and writing; add an update test with an adopter hook in extensions.yml.
findings.x-evidence: update stages init into an empty dir (line 81), so desired is the unmerged payload; when the merged file is unmodified since install (line 112 passes) it is replaced at line 127.

findings.title: Shipped troubleshooting docs name a single organisation's internal package-feed hostnames
findings.x-fix: Replace the two feed URLs with a generic "your organisation's approved npm/PyPI mirror" and show the env vars (npm_config_registry, UV_DEFAULT_INDEX) with placeholder values.
findings.x-evidence: constitution.md:93 forbids adopter-specific hostnames in Baton; lines 27-28 contain them and the denylist does not catch hostnames.

findings.title: diff-nonempty is empty once implement increments are merged to main and trivially true from baton bookkeeping
findings.x-fix: Evaluate against a base recorded in the baton (e.g. the commit of the phase that started implement) or accept an explicit base, and exclude specs/*/handoff.md, .baton/ and untracked scratch files from the count.
findings.x-evidence: This review hit it: receive --phase review failed "0 changed files" on origin/main because PRs #1-#20 were merged; changedFiles (line 61) diffs merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD and adds untracked files. Override recorded as a baton decision.

findings.title: acceptance-evidence regex can be satisfied by registry headers or placeholder text, and the id is not escaped
findings.x-fix: Parse the Acceptance Registry table and require a non-placeholder red->green (or justified n/a) evidence cell per registered id; escape item.id before building the RegExp; add negative tests.
findings.x-evidence: Any line with the id followed by the words red, green or n/a passes, including the registry row header text.

findings.title: --from-json replaces decisions and open_questions wholesale, so an agent can delete human answers or forge human:* decisions
findings.x-fix: Merge decisions append-only: keep existing ids unchanged, reject supplied entries whose by starts with human: and never drop an existing blocking question except via handoff answer.
findings.x-evidence: Object.assign(data, supplied) at line 293 overwrites arrays; handoff answer (213-227) is the only intended path to resolve a question.

findings.title: refresh re-hashes every artifact including the baton itself, keeps a prior gate approval and crashes without decisions
findings.x-fix: Skip the baton file itself, reset gate.approved_by when a gated source-of-truth hash changes, and default data.decisions ??= [] before push (line 392).
findings.x-evidence: A quick baton listed in its own artifacts becomes permanently stale after refresh; the gate survives changed artifacts.

findings.title: W_WEAKENED_CONTRACT compares only exit checks, so a phases.yml override can drop human_gate or entry gate checks silently
findings.x-fix: Also compare each default entry check and warn when human_gate is turned off; add phases unit tests.
findings.x-evidence: checkWeakenedContracts uses phaseForLane(defaults, lane).exit only.

findings.title: update reports a conflict (exit 4) on every run for a customised constitution
findings.x-fix: Skip protected paths (init.mjs:15 protectedPath) in update exactly as init does, instead of comparing them to the pristine template.
findings.x-evidence: init plans the constitution from the template (init.mjs:217-219); an adopter edit makes the digest differ from the manifest, so line 112 writes a conflict every update.

findings.title: update restages with --packs only, dropping an adopter's --script ps/py choice
findings.x-fix: Record the script flavour in the manifest at init and pass --script <flavour> when staging in update.
findings.x-evidence: Only --packs and --from are forwarded, so ps/py script installs are replaced by sh scripts or reported as conflicts.

findings.title: Contracted warnings W_NO_BATON and W_ASSUMPTION_DUE are never emitted
findings.x-fix: Emit W_NO_BATON for a specs dir with spec.md and no handoff.md (suggest handoff init --infer) and W_ASSUMPTION_DUE when an assumption revisit_at equals next_phase; add validate tests.
findings.x-evidence: handoff-contract.md:115-118 defines both; no source file references either code.

findings.title: Malformed review.json crashes the findings checks with E_INTERNAL (exit 10) instead of an unmet check
findings.x-fix: Wrap JSON.parse in try/catch and return answer(false, "review.json is not valid JSON: ..."); add a test.
findings.x-evidence: findings-json-valid is meant to report invalid findings files, but a parse error escapes evaluateBuiltIn.

findings.title: A failing local-checks-pass entry check is reported as E_MISSING_ARTIFACT
findings.x-fix: Map local-checks-pass to a dedicated code (e.g. E_CHECK_FAILED) or E_EXIT_UNMET with the per-check exit codes, and test a failing configured check.
findings.x-evidence: The receive code mapping falls through to E_MISSING_ARTIFACT for every unlisted check id, which misleads the land phase.

findings.title: lock verify has no tests and malformed lock JSON surfaces as E_INTERNAL
findings.x-fix: Add tests for a matching lock, a tampered file (E_LOCK_MISMATCH) and malformed JSON mapped to a documented code.
findings.x-evidence: No test references lock verify or E_LOCK_MISMATCH although CI relies on it.

findings.title: Relay tests miss converge write, write-with-pending-gate and answer/approve guard paths
findings.x-fix: Add relay cases: converge receive+write, write while a gate is pending (expect exit 3), answer with an unknown id or choice, approve twice.
findings.x-evidence: Only the converge receive is asserted; F01/F03 would have been caught.

findings.title: update/init --from archive is not checked against the release SHA256SUMS
findings.x-fix: Verify the archive digest against a SHA256SUMS file next to it (or a --sha256 flag) before extracting.
findings.x-evidence: contracts/ci.md:110 publishes SHA256SUMS; src has no reference to it.

findings.title: local-checks-pass runs shell commands from the branch's own .baton/config.yml during receive/write
findings.x-fix: Document the trust boundary and print the commands before running them in receive land; optionally require config.yml checks to match the default branch.
findings.x-evidence: A PR that edits config.yml checks gets command execution when a reviewer runs the land receive.

findings.title: The personal-data scan strips code spans and fences in Markdown, so identities inside backticks pass
findings.x-fix: Scan code spans too but allow documented placeholder domains (example.com/.invalid) instead of skipping all code.
findings.x-evidence: Lines 31-33 remove fenced and inline code before matching.

findings.title: mvp-windows-smoke.yml is not in the maintainer workflow list, so guard checks and --prune-workflows skip it
findings.x-fix: Add mvp-windows-smoke.yml to maintainerWorkflows and the template-cleanup dormant list.
findings.x-evidence: The workflow is guarded (line 10) but not listed.

findings.title: A paragraph splits the adopter command table, so the models apply, adopt and uninstall rows do not render
findings.x-fix: Move the implement -> review paragraph below the table (after the uninstall row).
findings.x-evidence: Lines 42-44 interrupt the table.

findings.title: handoff next omits gate and status, so agents must also call show to know they are blocked
findings.x-fix: Include status, gate.required/approved_by and blocking question ids in the next payload.
findings.x-evidence: The payload has command, role, model and instruction only.

findings.title: baton-review skill does not specify the --from-json payload shape or --next implement for blocking findings
findings.x-fix: Document the review object ({findings_path, blocking_findings}) and require --next implement/work while F02 is open.
findings.x-evidence: Agents must read handoff.mjs to learn the allowed keys.

findings.title: Tests create temp repos inside the source tree (test/fixtures/handoffs/.relay-*) which are not gitignored
findings.x-fix: Create temp repos under os.tmpdir() or add the prefixes to .gitignore.
findings.x-evidence: An interrupted test run leaves untracked dirs that also feed diff-nonempty/changedFiles.

findings.title: phaseDefaults duplicates baton/templates/phases.yml with only a partial drift check
findings.x-fix: Add a unit test asserting deep equality between phaseDefaults and the parsed template (or generate one from the other at build).
findings.x-evidence: Only exit checks are compared today.

findings.title: Malformed --from-json exits 10 (E_INTERNAL) instead of a usage error
findings.x-fix: Catch JSON.parse and throw E_USAGE exit 2 naming the file.
findings.x-evidence: JSON.parse is unguarded.
